result.message: Good consolidation moment: your first ROUTE (P_4HZZZIUVHM) was evidence-backed — E_WBNVMNEXHU showed that exact port from CURRENT reaching N_C7MPVE63SK, and E_I4LCPN5SPW showed that node reaching GOAL via P_GLX6SNZX56. That worked correctly! The failure was the second attempt: you tried P_AP6SWBMEX6, a port not listed at the new CURRENT node — the events never showed that leading to GOAL. Lesson: only route on ports actually listed and evidenced for your current node.
result.rationale: Distinguishing the successful evidence-grounded first route from the invalid second attempt, without inventing new claims, to help the learner internalize evidence-based routing versus guessing on unlisted ports.
